title: About Me
text:
I am a health economist and biostatistician with a PhD in Genetic Epidemiology from the Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU) and hands-on health technology assessment (HTA) appraisal experience at PenTAG, University of Exeter.
My core focus is on economic evaluation, health economic modelling, evidence synthesis (NMA, MAIC, STC), and real-world data (RWD) registry analyses to inform healthcare reimbursement and clinical decision-making.

title: About Me
text:
Passion & Hobbies

Open Source R & Tooling: Building modular R packages, interactive R Shiny dashboards, and transparent health-analytics pipelines.
Methodological Research: Exploring genetic epidemiology, polygenic risk scores (PRS), and causal inference methodologies in large biobank cohorts (HUNT, Norwegian Patient Registry).
Global Health & Science Communication: Translating complex statistical evidence and registry analyses into accessible insights for clinicians, patients, and policy-makers.

text:
Tip

title: Industry & HTA Experience
text:
PenTAG, University of Exeter (March 2026 – Present)
Role: Research Assistant in HTA Tags: NICE HTA Appraisals Cost-Effectiveness Modelling R Excel VBA

STAs & MTAs: Critically appraised industry-submitted cost-effectiveness models across 4 Single Technology Appraisals (STAs) and 1 Multiple Technology Appraisal (MTA) spanning 4 therapy areas for NICE committees.
Decision Models: Developed and adapted de novo decision models and existing NICE models in R and Excel VBA.
Client Consultancy: Appraised R as an alternative for cost-effectiveness modelling for a client.

title: Industry & HTA Experience
text:
Parexel (July 2021 – February 2022)
Role: Associate, Advanced Analytics (Remote) Tags: Evidence Synthesis NMA MAIC STC WinBUGS R Shiny

Evidence Synthesis: Contributed to network meta-analyses (NMA), matching-adjusted indirect comparisons (MAIC), and simulated treatment comparisons (STC) in R.
Sensitivity Analyses: Conducted probabilistic sensitivity analyses in WinBUGS.
Dashboards & Platforms: Contributed to a Shiny-based cost-effectiveness platform and built interactive dashboards in R Shiny and Excel VBA for survival, treatment, and demographic outcomes.

title: MSA
text:
I work as a Research Assistant at PenTAG.
I appraise health economic models submitted as part of health technology assessment (HTA) submissions to the National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) in the UK. I also conduct research on health economic modelling methods and applications.
For collaboration or to simply chat 👇
